semiconductor_relevance: High — Dongguan XY New Material Co., Ltd. specializes in advanced materials crucial for semiconductor manufacturing and packaging.
summary: Dongguan XY New Material Co., Ltd. is a leader in the development and production of advanced ceramics and tungsten carbide components tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products enhance chip manufacturing efficiency and quality, focusing on high-temperature resistance and precision required in wafer handling and equipment cores.
capabilities: Advanced ceramics with high temperature resistance (over 800℃)
Tungsten carbide parts for equipment cores
Custom solutions from design to mass production
Precision components with ISO Class 1 cleanliness
technical_expertise: Quality control processes in semiconductor materials

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Dongguan, China, focusing on R&D and production for the semiconductor sector.
